name: attendee-list
title: Attendee list
description: Who is coming: attendees with their response, grouped counts and your own RSVP, for meetings and events.
docs: attendees is { id, name, email, image, response, optional } with a response of accepted, declined, tentative or none. The list opens with counts (4 yes, 1 maybe, 2 waiting, left out when zero) that are a polite status, so a change is read out, and a thin bar of the same shares. Each answer is written out as Accepted, Tentative, Declined or No response and drawn as a different shape, so none depends on colour. organizer and you are attendee ids: the organizer leads and carries a tag, you come next with three buttons (Yes, Maybe, No) that call onRespond and may return a promise, and only the organizer sees a Remind button on rows that have not answered, calling onRemind (also a promise: busy, then Reminded). maxVisible (default 5) folds the rest behind Show 12 more and never folds the organizer or you away. The row reads its own width: narrow, the answer moves under the name. headingLevel sets the heading (2 to 4) and labels translates every word.
